# clEsperanto Documentation

This repository hold the documentation of the clEsperanto.

## Local build

The documentation can be locally build using the pixi task ```pixi run build```

## Online build

The online documentation is versioned.

**Latest** is automatically generated after the merge of PR
**Releasing** a version with the same tag as clesperanto will generate a pinned version of the documentation
**Stable** is latest released version of the documentation.

Version tag must correspond to a CLIc version
